product: Fictional single-page homepage for a community used-book exchange platform
audience: City residents ages 25 to 40 who want a finished book to keep circulating
tone: Warm, restrained, trustworthy, and free of exaggerated marketing

hero.h1: Let a finished book meet its next reader.
hero.sub: Community book exchange, nearby, with less waste.

features_region_note: The feature section is variable length: the default has three items and the long-content case has six. The layout must remain usable.

features.title: Nearby matches
features.body: Find books you want to read in your area, with pickup or delivery.

features.title: Trust points
features.body: Reliable handoffs and honest condition notes help build trust.

features.title: Transparent condition
features.body: See notes about creases, annotations, and wear before exchanging.

states.empty: Enter a book title, area, and email to continue.
states.error: Fix the fields marked in red, then try again.
states.success: Your book is listed. We will contact you within two business days.
